verdict: Volume is down this week; efficiency held — overdue build-outs are the bottleneck.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 36 leads at $44.08 per lead on $1,586.80 in total spend. This past week, spend pulled back roughly 31% and lead volume followed at nearly the same rate — however, your cost per lead barely moved (-2%), meaning the ads themselves are still working efficiently at a lower volume. The contraction is tied to a set of planned build-outs — heating campaigns, fall creative, LSA re-activation, and intake setup — that remain unfinished and are holding back the scale-up that was scoped for this period. Those items are being worked through now, and once the budget re-raise and remaining milestones clear, volume is expected to recover and grow heading into heating season.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period across all paid channels
cost per lead — held nearly flat even as spend pulled back
pipeline opportunities marked won in your CRM this period

watch_item.issue: Nine planned milestones — including heating campaigns, fall creative, and LSA re-activation — are overdue, capping volume at a point where scale-up should already be underway.
watch_item.fix: These items are being cleared in sequence this week; the budget re-raise is scoped for October 31 once intake and campaign infrastructure are confirmed live.
